caption.zh: 三栏对应论文摘要的三项设计承诺：p ≥ 2^512、q ≥ 2^140 的子群参数；公钥签名与对应认证；相对 ElGamal 的更快签名、更短签名和随机指数预处理。
caption.en: Three panels match the abstract’s design promises: subgroup parameters p ≥ 2^512 and q ≥ 2^140; a public-key signature and corresponding authentication; and faster signing, shorter signatures, and random-exponent preprocessing relative to ElGamal.

alt.zh: 左栏画 Z_p* 内的 q 阶子群与生成元 α，并列出 p、q、α 三条参数；中栏画签名笔与认证勾，附论文原话；右栏画秒表，列出更快、更短、预处理三点。底部注明论文标题与“不是部署记录”。
alt.en: Left panel draws the order-q subgroup inside Z_p* with generator α and lists p, q, α; middle panel draws a signing pen and an authentication check plus the paper wording; right panel draws a stopwatch and lists faster, shorter, preprocessing. The footer gives the paper title and says it is not a deployment record.

caption.zh: 四步展示 de Rooij 对 Schnorr 预处理的攻击：k=8 对随机指数、线性组合、收集约 700 个签名/记录、约 2^31 步恢复秘密密钥。下方对比论文猜测的 2^72 安全水平。
caption.en: Four steps show de Rooij’s attack on Schnorr preprocessing: k=8 pairs, linear combinations, about 700 signatures/transcripts, and about 2^31 steps to recover the secret key. Below, the paper’s conjectured 2^72 security level is contrasted.

alt.zh: 四张步骤卡：预计算 8 对 (r_i,x_i)；组合成 (r,x)；收集约 700 个签名；解出私钥。底部对比条：论文猜测 k=8 预处理安全 2^72，de Rooij 约 2^31 步 + 700 签名；注明对数刻度示意。页脚说攻击针对预处理，不是无预处理的核心签名。
alt.en: Four step cards: precompute 8 pairs (r_i,x_i); combine into (r,x); collect about 700 signatures; recover the private key. A comparison bar says the paper conjectures 2^72 security for k=8 preprocessing, while de Rooij needs about 2^31 steps and 700 signatures; it is marked as a log-scale schematic. The footer says the attack is on preprocessing, not the core signature without it.

caption.zh: 把 1989 年欧洲专利申请、1991 年 1 月 Journal of Cryptology 4(3): 161–174、1991 年 2 月美国专利放在同一条时间线上；读法明确本条只把文章断到 1991 年期刊论文。
caption.en: Places the 1989 European patent application, the January 1991 Journal of Cryptology 4(3): 161–174 article, and the February 1991 US patent on one timeline; the reading rule dates this entry only to the 1991 journal article.

alt.zh: 横向时间线三个节点：1989-02-24 欧洲专利申请 89103290.6；1991-01 Journal of Cryptology 4(3): 161–174；1991-02-19 美国专利 4995082。下方两张卡列“论文给出”与“论文不给出”，底部读法说明专利日期不是期刊发表年。
alt.en: A horizontal timeline with three nodes: 1989-02-24 European patent application 89103290.6; 1991-01 Journal of Cryptology 4(3): 161–174; 1991-02-19 US patent 4995082. Two cards below list what the paper gives and does not give; the reading rule says the patent dates are not the journal publication year.
